basis: Individually inspected BASE-N numeric instruction spans, translated as integer and decimal-value algorithms. Value APIs do not claim RAM scratch/register equivalence; unlisted callees are not inferred from calls.

ranges.scope: 32-bit two's-complement negation; biased ten-digit decimal extraction; BCD magnitude conversion modulo 2^32 and BIN carry admission; signed32/BIN signed16 serialization and decimal normalization; canonical marked/rational/surd/error operand bias dispatch and exact returning BIN rejection partial serialization
Canonical scalar metadata NOT and checked NEG; incoming BIN carry ignored; exact partial serialization and native CPU/RAM recurrence boundary; minimum word and range rejection retain original record
Full 32-bit OR/XOR/XNOR/AND with canonical scalar metadata conversion; incoming BIN carry ignored and returning BIN partial serialization preserved; proven zero residual pair recurrence explicit
Mode2 successful-operation range admission; zero fast path, signed16 BIN versus signed32 other masks, inclusive negative/exclusive positive limit, skip for other mode or prior status
ADD/SUBTRACT/MULTIPLY computed-value range checks; successful mode2 DIV truncation toward zero without range check

Stored-scalar fetch adapter control: mode2 conversion/truncation/range check and R2 status, preserved context; bank-copy effects are delegated and not claimed by value API; canonical empty-payload 6x/9x stored references reject as F3 without cell fetch

Radix literal digit packing/scanning, prefix selection, zero suppression, significant widths, lexical/selected-base ranges, signed interpretation, error partial record writes and returned cursor/status/kind; scratch digit buffer is not exported
